changelog:
## v1.9.30

- Fix: Resolved infinite auto-reload loop when adding variable products to bundle checkout
- Enhanced: Variable products now automatically resolve and match valid variations on selection to prevent empty cart rejects
- Added: woocommerce_checkout_redirect_empty_cart filter and AJAX reload suppressor
- Full Control Parity: Integrated multi-product bundle mode directly into the core widget so all 5,000+ lines of checkout layouts, order bump, typography, borders, and animations are 100% available in both Single and Bundle modes
